title: shift of calibration point in graph
symptom: When entering a calibration reading, the red dot (calibration point) on the xDrip graph appears shifted about 10 minutes later than the actual time, even though the time information shows the current time. The user asks if this is due to the Libre's delay or a bug.
cause: The delay is intentional. The graph displays all data in terms of the delayed interstitial fluid response, so blood glucose readings are shifted to align with the Libre readings, even if not used for calibration.
fix: No fix was provided; the behavior is intentional. The thread suggests that a tutorial screen might be needed to inform users, and there is discussion of possibly allowing the main screen to show current/estimated BG values instead, but no code change was made.
